title.zh: Jump、DRW押注AI算力期货市场，2030年市场规模或达2.3万亿美元
title.en: Jump、DRW押注AI算力期货市场，2030年市场规模或达2.3万亿美元

current_state.zh: Jump Trading and DRW are building dedicated AI-compute derivatives trading teams to make markets in GPU-rental futures being prepared by CME, Silicon Data, ICE and Ornn, betting compute becomes a standardized, hedgeable asset even as pricing transparency and storability problems remain unresolved.
current_state.en: Jump Trading and DRW are building dedicated AI-compute derivatives trading teams to make markets in GPU-rental futures being prepared by CME, Silicon Data, ICE and Ornn, betting compute becomes a standardized, hedgeable asset even as pricing transparency and storability problems remain unresolved.
